faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheadline: Straightforward answers about hiring me, pricing, communication, and how we work together.
faq.q1: Are you available for freelance projects or contract work?
faq.a1: Yes, I am actively available for both fixed-price freelance projects (like building a new web app or adding features) and ongoing contract roles (part-time or full-time remote). Send me a message to check current availability.
faq.q2: What tech stack do you work with?
faq.a2: I mainly use React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Node.js for code, PostgreSQL and MySQL for databases, and Docker on Linux servers for hosting.
faq.q3: Can you help set up hosting and domain?
faq.a3: Yes, I handle the entire deployment process. I configure your domain, set up automatic SSL certificates (HTTPS), and deploy the app with Docker on an affordable Linux VPS.
faq.q4: How do we communicate during the project?
faq.a4: We can talk via WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, or Email — whatever fits your workflow best. For meetings or project reviews, we can do quick Google Meet or Zoom calls.
faq.q5: What support do you provide after launch?
faq.a5: Every project includes free bug-fix support for the first 30 days after launch. If you need ongoing maintenance, new features, or server monitoring later on, we can do a simple monthly retainer.
faq.q6: Can you help university students with capstone or thesis projects?
faq.a6: Yes. I help computer science students build working prototypes for their final year projects, deploy them live, and explain the code so they are fully prepared for defense.
faq.q7: How do you handle timezone differences with US, UK, or EU clients?
faq.a7: I maintain 4 to 6 hours of daily overlap with US (Eastern & Pacific) and European/UK working hours. You will get fast responses during your workday and clear weekly video demos.
faq.q8: Who owns the code and intellectual property?
faq.a8: You own 100% of the code and intellectual property as soon as milestones are completed. I provide full access to the GitHub repository and all server credentials.
